description:
?Powerful 250W Motor with 70Nm Torque – EU Legal
The HITWAY BK10S PRO folding electric bike features a 250W rear hub motor that complies with UK road regulations, yet offers an impressive 70Nm torque for confident climbing and off-road capability. Perfect for hilly commutes or outdoor adventures.
?Samsung Battery, 720Wh Capacity – Long-Lasting Performance
The HITWAY BK10S PRO features a 48V 15Ah lithium battery built with high-quality Samsung cells, delivering an impressive 720Wh of energy, and delivers an impressive?range of 70–120 km (43–75 miles) on a single charge. This means?longer rides with fewer charges, better reliability, and peace of mind — whether you're commuting or exploring trails.
?Precision Hydraulic Disc Brakes – Superior Stopping Power

Upgraded with high-performance hydraulic disc brakes on both front and rear wheels, the BK10S PRO offers superior safety compared to traditional mechanical brakes. Enjoy smoother modulation, significantly stronger stopping power with less finger effort, and reliable braking performance in wet conditions or on steep descents.
?All-Terrain Performance – 20x4.0" Fat Tires + Dual Suspension
Take on any surface with ease thanks to puncture-resistant 20x4.0-inch fat tires, a front suspension fork with lockout, and a mid-frame shock absorber. From city streets to rugged trails, enjoy maximum stability, traction, and comfort.
?Smart LCD Display Control – Real-Time Ride Data
Monitor your ride like never before with the upgraded LCD display, showing speed, mileage, and battery status. Plus, unlock instant startup with built-in NFC — just tap your phone or card to power on, no fumbling for keys or apps, giving you full control at your fingertips.
?Thoughtful Features for Safety & Comfort
Ride day and night with confidence using StVZO-certified front and rear LED lights, high-visibility brake lights, and a rear luggage rack for daily convenience. Safety and functionality, all in one sleek folding electric bike.
